title: decorator-kit.json
description: Written into a project by `ucsd-decorator-kit init` or `add`. Declares the writable canvas, where Decorator markup is read from, and exactly which files the kit owns in this project.

kitVersion.description: The ucsd-decorator-kit version that last wrote the managed files. `check` compares against the installed version and fails when they differ.

canvas.description: CSS selector for the one writable region. Everything else on the page is chrome. `main#main-content` for a plain Decorator template and for tritonai-website.

decorator.description: Where Decorator markup is resolved from.

readFrom.description: On-disk path agents read templates, base.css and base.min.js from — not an import specifier.

manages.description: Exactly the paths this kit owns here. `sync` rewrites these and nothing else; `check` verifies these and nothing else. A file absent from this list can never be reached by either command — which is how a repository keeps its own AGENTS.md when `add` declined to write one.

thirdParty.description: Built third-party JavaScript — a framework runtime split into its own chunk, a vendored component bundle — that the chrome integrity gate's tier 4 script scan skips. Project-relative paths or globs (`**` any depth, `*` and `?` within one path segment); each must start with a literal directory or file name. A bare path matches that file or everything under that directory. CSS is never skipped. Human-owned scope: every `verify` run prints what it skipped, and the CI workflow flags a pull request that changes this list. Never add an entry to make a finding go away — see checks/README.md.
